idea-plugin.name: JTools
idea-plugin.description:
JTools is a powerful and lightweight plugin management container designed specifically for JetBrains IDEs. It revolutionizes the plugin development experience by providing hot-plugging capabilities, allowing developers to install, update, and uninstall plugins without restarting the IDE.
📖 Documentation | 🐛 Report Issues | 📦 Releases

✨ Key Features

  • 🔌 Hot-Plugging Support: Install and uninstall plugins on-the-fly without IDE restart, significantly improving development efficiency.
  • 📦 Drag & Drop Installation: Simply drag plugin files into the panel for instant installation, with right-click context menu for easy uninstallation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Language Development: Full support for Java, Kotlin, and JavaScript plugin development with rapid debugging capabilities.
  • 📂 Customizable Storage: Configure your preferred plugin installation directory with automatic isolation by JetBrains product and version.
  • 📋 Integrated Logging: Built-in logging console with soft-wrap output for easy troubleshooting during development and runtime.
  • 🤖 Agent Chat: Built-in agent entry with streaming output, reasoning blocks, and collapsible tool logs.
  • 📊 Token Usage: Agent chat shows per-session token consumption in K units near the prompt selector, with input/output and last-request details in the tooltip.
  • 🧭 Provider Manager: Multi-provider configuration (OpenAI/Anthropic) with base URL, headers, and proxy.
  • 🎛️ Provider Selector: Provider selector with model lists fetched from each provider.
  • 🧩 Provider Templates: OpenAI-compatible provider types and vendor templates with preset endpoints and parameter hints for easier third-party model integration.
  • 🌍 Broad Provider Coverage: Built-in templates for OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Gemini, Ollama, and Anthropic-style integrations.
  • 🧰 Function Calling: Aggregated plugin and system tools with unique identifiers to avoid name conflicts.
  • 📦 Plugin Ops: Local/URL/batch install and uninstall tool calls for faster workflows.
  • 🧪 Dev Testing: Developer panel can expose current plugin instance tool calls for debugging.
  • 📎 Attachment Workflow: Attach local files and images to chat, with model-aware capability checks, clipboard support, and optimized upload handling.
  • 🖼️ Multimodal Inputs: Per-model capability switches for image, audio, video, and file attachments, with automatic text extraction for readable files.
  • 🧠 Skill Management: Import or edit local SKILL.md skills, attach them per session, and expose skill resources directly to the agent runtime.
  • 📚 Skill Resources: references/examples/scripts resources can be mounted into agent sessions and read through dedicated resource tools.
  • 🔗 Skill Runtime Integration: Skills share the same runtime Toolkit as built-in and plugin tools, keeping SkillBox tool groups aligned with the active agent session.
  • 🛠️ Built-in Agent Tools: JTools exposes system-level tools for plugin operations, file browsing, skill CRUD, session skill toggles, and MCP management.
  • 🛡️ Agent Permissions: Per-chat access scopes and dangerous-operation policies control file, shell, plugin, skill, MCP, and dynamically registered tools.
  • 🎚️ Model Tuning: Configure per-model streaming, multimodal capabilities, and advanced OpenAI/Anthropic parameters from a dedicated tuning panel.
  • 🧾 Parameter Guidance: Store provider-level default and recommended parameters to make model configuration more repeatable across sessions.
  • 💾 Session Persistence: Restore sessions, enabled skills, draft attachments, and active context across projects for long-running conversations.
  • 🧠 Runtime State: Session runtime can preserve memory, tool state, and planning context for more consistent multi-step workflows.
  • ⚙️ Agent Limits: Configurable max tool iterations and tool result size limits to prevent oversized context.
  • 📂 File Listing: jtools_list_files supports maxEntries with truncation metadata.
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch: WebFetch works as a direct HTTP client with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS, query params, headers, raw bodies, form params, timeout control, and Web tool proxy settings.
  • 🧭 AI Browser Tools: Browser tools can open a temporary JCEF browser session, run visible or hidden after user choice, read pages, observe element refs, click, type, wait, capture screenshots, and destroy the dynamic tool window when finished.
  • 🔧 Dynamic SDK Management: Automatic SDK dependency resolution for IDEA, Maven, and Gradle projects.
  • 🌐 Web Integration: JavaScript plugins enable flexible web page integration with custom development options.
  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Open multiple instances of the same plugin simultaneously with proper resource management.
  • 📐 Split Panel View: Support for left-right panel splitting for better workspace organization.
  • 🎯 JetBrains Family Support: Compatible with the entire JetBrains IDE family including IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, and more.

🎯 Use Cases

  • Rapid prototyping and testing of IntelliJ plugins
  • Creating lightweight utility tools without full plugin overhead
  • Developing custom web-based tools integrated into the IDE
  • Building team-specific development tools with easy distribution
  • Running an IDE-native agent workspace with providers, skills, MCP servers, and attachments in one panel
  • Connecting private or third-party model services through vendor templates without rebuilding the plugin workflow

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Install JTools from the JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open the JTools panel from the right sidebar
  3. Drag and drop your plugin files or use the built-in development tools
  4. Start developing with hot-reload support!
📖 帮助文档 | 🐛 问题反馈 | 📦 版本发布

🛠️ JTools - 轻量级插件容器

JTools 是一个专为 JetBrains IDE 设计的强大且轻量级的插件管理容器。它通过提供热插拔功能彻底改变了插件开发体验，允许开发者在不重启 IDE 的情况下安装、更新和卸载插件。

✨ 核心特性

  • 🔌 热插拔支持：无需重启 IDE 即可即时安装和卸载插件，显著提升开发效率。
  • 📦 拖拽安装：只需将插件文件拖入面板即可立即安装，右键菜单轻松卸载。
  • 🚀 多语言开发：全面支持 Java、Kotlin 和 JavaScript 插件开发，具备快速调试能力。
  • 📂 自定义存储：可配置首选的插件安装目录，按 JetBrains 产品和版本自动隔离。
  • 📋 集成日志：内置日志控制台，支持软换行输出，便于开发和运行时故障排查。
  • 🤖 智能体对话：内置智能体入口，支持流式输出、推理块展示与工具调用折叠日志。
  • 📊 Token 消耗：智能体对话在提示词选择器旁展示当前会话 Token 累计消耗，按 K 单位显示，并在提示中提供输入/输出与上次请求明细。
  • 🧭 供应方管理：多供应方配置（OpenAI/Anthropic），支持 Base URL、请求头、代理。
  • 🎛️ 供应方选择：对话中可选供应方，并维护供应方级别模型列表与默认模型。
  • 🧩 供应方模板：支持 OpenAI Compatible 接入类型与厂商模板，预置端点和参数建议，便于接入第三方模型服务。
  • 🌍 广泛供应方覆盖：内置 OpenAI、DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、DashScope、Gemini、Ollama、Anthropic 等接入模板。
  • 🧰 函数调用：聚合插件与系统工具并增加唯一标识，避免名称冲突。
  • 📦 插件管理：支持本地/URL/批量安装与卸载的工具调用。
  • 🧪 开发测试：开发面板可暴露当前插件实例的工具调用用于调试。
  • 📎 附件工作流：对话支持本地文件和图片附件，具备模型能力校验、剪贴板支持与上传优化。
  • 🖼️ 多模态输入：可按模型开启图片、音频、视频、文件附件能力，并对可读文件自动抽取文本上下文。
  • 🧠 Skills 管理：支持导入或编辑本地 SKILL.md 技能，按会话挂载，并将技能资源直接暴露给智能体运行时。
  • 📚 Skills 资源：references/examples/scripts 等资源文件可随技能挂载，并通过专用资源工具读取。
  • 🔗 Skill 运行时集成：Skills 与内置工具、插件工具共享同一个运行时 Toolkit，使 SkillBox 工具组与当前智能体会话保持一致。
  • 🛠️ 内置智能体工具：提供插件管理、文件浏览、技能增删改查、会话技能开关与 MCP 管理等系统工具。
  • 🛡️ 智能体权限：按对话配置访问范围与危险操作策略，统一管控文件、命令、插件、Skills、MCP 和动态注册工具。
  • 🎚️ 模型调优：提供独立模型调优面板，可配置流式输出、多模态能力以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 高级参数。
  • 🧾 参数建议：支持保存供应方默认参数与推荐参数，让模型配置在不同会话中更容易复用。
  • 💾 会话持久化：跨项目保留会话、启用的技能、草稿附件与当前上下文，适合长会话持续协作。
  • 🧠 运行时状态：会话运行时可保留记忆、工具状态与规划上下文，适合多步骤连续任务。
  • ⚙️ 智能体限制：可配置最大工具调用轮次并限制工具返回长度，避免超大上下文。
  • 📂 文件列表：jtools_list_files 支持 maxEntries 并返回截断信息。
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch：WebFetch 改为直接 HTTP 客户端，支持 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS、查询参数、请求头、原始请求体、表单参数、超时控制和 Web 工具代理。
  • 🧭 AI 浏览器工具：浏览器工具可创建临时 JCEF 浏览器会话，在用户选择后显示或隐藏运行，支持读取页面、观察元素 ref、点击、输入、等待、截图，并在完成后销毁动态工具窗口。
  • 🔧 动态 SDK 管理：自动解析 IDEA、Maven 和 Gradle 项目的 SDK 依赖。
  • 🌐 Web 集成：JavaScript 插件支持灵活的网页集成和自定义开发。
  • 🪟 多实例支持：支持同时打开同一插件的多个实例，并具备完善的资源管理。
  • 📐 分割面板视图：支持左右面板分割，更好地组织工作空间。
  • 🎯 JetBrains 全家桶支持：兼容整个 JetBrains IDE 系列，包括 IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm 等。

🎯 应用场景

  • IntelliJ 插件的快速原型开发和测试
  • 创建轻量级实用工具，无需完整插件开销
  • 开发集成到 IDE 中的自定义 Web 工具
  • 构建团队专用开发工具，便于分发
  • 在 IDE 内运行一体化智能体工作台，统一管理供应方、Skills、MCP 与附件
  • 通过厂商模板快速接入私有或第三方模型服务，而不必重建整套插件工作流

🚀 快速开始

  1. 从 JetBrains Marketplace 安装 JTools
  2. 从右侧边栏打开 JTools 面板
  3. 拖放插件文件或使用内置开发工具
  4. 开始享受热重载开发体验！
idea-plugin.change-notes:
📦 Version v1.1.4.4

Latest Release / 最新版本

  • 🧭 AI Browser Tool Enhancements: Built on the v1.1.4.3 browser flow with browser_snapshot, browser_click_ref, browser_type_ref, browser_click_text, browser_wait_for_text, browser_wait_for_selector, browser_screenshot, and browser_press
  • 🔎 Observable Browser Actions: browser_snapshot returns actionable element refs so the agent can prefer ref-based click/type operations, wait for page changes, and observe again instead of guessing CSS selectors
  • 🧾 Browser Tool Prompting: Browser tool descriptions now guide the agent toward the open -> snapshot -> ref action -> wait -> snapshot/read -> close workflow, with CSS selector tools kept as fallback operations
  • ✅ Browser Action Feedback: Browser click/type operations now report found and ok so the agent can tell whether an element was actually hit
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.4 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1144
  • 🧭 AI 浏览器工具增强：在 v1.1.4.3 浏览器工具链基础上新增 browser_snapshot、browser_click_ref、browser_type_ref、browser_click_text、browser_wait_for_text、browser_wait_for_selector、browser_screenshot 和 browser_press
  • 🔎 可观察浏览器操作：browser_snapshot 会返回可操作元素 ref，智能体优先通过 ref 点击和输入，页面变化后可等待文本/selector 并重新观察，减少盲猜 CSS selector
  • 🧾 浏览器工具提示词优化：浏览器工具描述明确推荐 open -> snapshot -> ref 操作 -> wait -> snapshot/read -> close 的操作流程，CSS selector 工具作为低优先级兜底
  • ✅ 浏览器动作反馈：browser_click / browser_type 等操作会返回 found 和 ok 状态，便于智能体判断元素是否真实命中
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：发布版本提升至 v1.1.4.4，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1144

📦 Version v1.1.4.3

  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch: Reworked WebFetch into a direct HTTP client for APIs and static resources, with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS, query params, headers, raw body, form params, timeout control, response headers, content metadata, and Web tool proxy support
  • 🧭 AI Browser Tools: Added a temporary JCEF browser tool flow with browser_open, browser_read, browser_click, browser_type, browser_scroll, browser_show, browser_hide, and browser_close
  • 👁️ Visible / Hidden Browser Runs: The agent must ask whether to run the browser visibly or hidden before opening it; visible runs create a dynamic AI Browser tool window and hidden runs keep the browser session off-screen
  • 🧹 Browser Lifecycle Cleanup: Browser sessions are reused within a project, the dynamic browser tool window is registered only while needed, JCEF load handlers are removed after navigation, and project disposal cleans up browser sessions
  • 🌐 Browser Proxy Alignment: Browser tools now use the same Web tool HTTP/SOCKS proxy settings as WebFetch and WebSearch, with a clear restart-required error if JCEF has already started before proxy initialization
  • 🧰 Tool Argument Serialization: Preserved nested object and array arguments when forwarding tool calls so structured parameters like headers, query params, and form params are delivered correctly
  • 🛠️ Model Manager Toolbar Fix: Fixed the SDK model list panel layout so the right-side add/refresh toolbar stays visible
  • 📊 Agent Token Usage: Added per-session token consumption display beside the agent prompt selector, using K-unit formatting and tooltip details for input, output, and last request usage
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.3 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1143
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch：WebFetch 改为面向接口和静态资源的直接 HTTP 客户端，支持 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS、查询参数、请求头、原始请求体、表单参数、超时控制、响应头、内容元数据和 Web 工具代理
  • 🧭 AI 浏览器工具：新增临时 JCEF 浏览器工具链，包含 browser_open、browser_read、browser_click、browser_type、browser_scroll、browser_show、browser_hide 和 browser_close
  • 👁️ 显示/隐藏浏览器运行：打开浏览器前智能体必须询问用户希望显示运行还是隐藏运行；显示运行会动态创建 AI Browser 工具窗口，隐藏运行则保持浏览器会话不展示
  • 🧹 浏览器生命周期清理：同一项目内复用浏览器会话，动态浏览器工具窗口仅在需要时注册，导航后移除 JCEF load handler，项目释放时自动清理浏览器会话
  • 🌐 浏览器代理对齐：浏览器工具使用与 WebFetch / WebSearch 相同的 Web 工具 HTTP/SOCKS 代理设置；如果 JCEF 已提前启动导致代理无法初始化，会返回需要重启 IDE 的明确错误
  • 🧰 工具参数序列化：工具调用转发时保留嵌套对象和数组参数，确保 headers、query params、form params 等结构化参数能正确传递
  • 🛠️ 模型管理工具栏修复：修正 SDK 模型列表面板布局，恢复右侧新增/刷新工具栏显示，避免按钮被布局挤出可视区域
  • 📊 智能体 Token 消耗：在智能体提示词选择器旁新增当前会话 Token 消耗展示，按 K 单位格式化，并通过提示展示输入、输出和上次请求用量
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：发布版本提升至 v1.1.4.3，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1143

📦 Version v1.1.4.2

Latest Release / 最新版本

  • 🎨 Settings UI Refresh: Reworked the settings page into grouped card sections with scrolling, separating general settings from Web tool configuration for clearer plugin directory, logging, repository, proxy, and search-engine controls
  • 🌐 Web Tool Proxy: Added dedicated HTTP/SOCKS proxy settings for WebFetch and WebSearch, with persisted host, port, and type applied to rendered fetches and search requests
  • 🔍 Search Engine Configuration: Added WebSearch engine management with add, edit, delete, drag-to-reorder, {query} URL placeholders, and legacy engine ID normalization
  • 🧭 Search Engine Scope: Removed the built-in Google search engine, made Bing the default search engine, kept Baidu as fallback, and automatically drops legacy Google engine configs during normalization
  • 🕒 Current Time Tool: Added the read-only jtools_get_current_time tool to return yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss time, requested timezone, and system timezone for an IANA timezone or UTC offset
  • 🧠 Skill Code Execution: Expanded uploaded Skill resource types, added assets and Windows script support, and improved cross-platform command whitelists and code-execution instructions
  • 🧾 Raw Markdown Viewer: Added a dedicated raw markdown viewer for fenced markdown/md sections anywhere in an assistant reply, preserving nested markdown/json/yml/xml fences instead of re-parsing them, with soft-wrapped long lines, a top-right copy button that copies the raw source text, and copy-success notifications
  • ✨ Streaming Render Stability: Reduced markdown streaming flicker by lowering full HTML re-render frequency and skipping duplicate render passes for unchanged content
  • 🧹 Search Parser Cleanup: Removed Google-specific result parsing and debug output to reduce CAPTCHA-triggering traffic and stale search-page parsing paths
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.2 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1142
  • 🧩 Agent Workspace Tuning: Refined the IDE-native agent workflow around Web fetch/search, skill execution, and provider-driven tooling so the latest release feels more consistent in day-to-day use
  • 🎨 设置页重构：设置页改为分组卡片与滚动布局，拆分基础设置和 Web 工具设置，提升插件目录、日志、仓库、代理和搜索引擎配置的可读性
  • 🌐 Web 工具代理配置：新增 WebFetch / WebSearch 专用 HTTP/SOCKS 代理设置，代理主机、端口和类型会持久化并在网页抓取、搜索请求中生效
  • 🔍 搜索引擎配置：新增 WebSearch 搜索引擎管理，可新增、编辑、删除和拖拽排序搜索引擎，地址支持 {query} 占位符并兼容旧引擎 ID
  • 🧭 搜索引擎收敛：移除内置 Google 搜索引擎，默认使用 Bing，并保留 Baidu 作为回退；旧配置中的 Google 引擎会在归一化时自动清理
  • 🕒 当前时间工具：新增只读 jtools_get_current_time 工具，可按 IANA 时区或 UTC 偏移返回 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 时间、查询时区和系统时区
  • 🧠 Skill 代码执行增强：Skill 运行时扩展上传资源类型、assets 目录和 Windows 脚本支持，补充跨平台命令白名单与代码执行提示
  • 🧾 Raw Markdown 显示：支持在智能体回复任意位置识别 fenced markdown/md raw 区块，保留内部嵌套的 markdown/json/yml/xml fence 而不再重新解析，长行自动软换行，右上角复制按钮会复制 raw 原文并提示成功
  • ✨ 流式渲染稳定性：降低 Markdown 流式输出时整段 HTML 重绘频率，并跳过未变化内容的重复渲染，减少大段内容输出时的闪烁
  • 🧹 搜索解析清理：移除 Google 专用结果解析与调试输出，减少触发人机识别和无效搜索页解析的可能
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：发布版本提升至 v1.1.4.2，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1142
  • 🧩 智能体工作台调优：围绕 Web 工具、技能执行和模型接入进一步打磨当前会话的交互一致性，提升日常使用时的连贯感

📦 Version v1.1.4.1

  • 🌐 Rendered Web Fetch: fetch now uses HtmlUnit to render pages, extract JavaScript-populated text, and return final URL, content type, rendered HTML, and truncation metadata
  • 🔍 Search Engine Fallback: Web search now falls back across Bing, Baidu, and Google with Jsoup-based result parsing instead of relying on a single DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint
  • 🧭 Domain Filtering: Search allow/block filters now normalize domains, support subdomain matching, and drop noisy search, script, mail, and phone links
  • 🧠 Skill Code Execution: SkillBox enables a temporary workspace, script/data resource upload, and a restricted shell tool so scripts/ and data/ resources are available at runtime
  • 🧹 Tool Surface Cleanup: Removed custom Skill resource reader tools and the environment-variable reader tool; Skill resources are handled by built-in SkillBox capabilities to reduce sensitive-data exposure
  • 🧾 Copyable Tool Details: Tool-call detail popups now focus read-only JSON editors so arguments and results can be quickly selected and copied with keyboard shortcuts
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.1 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1141
  • 🌐 网页读取增强：fetch 改为基于 HtmlUnit 渲染页面，支持 JavaScript 后的正文提取，并返回最终 URL、内容类型、渲染 HTML 与截断状态
  • 🔍 搜索引擎回退：网页搜索从 DuckDuckGo 单一路径升级为 Bing、Baidu、Google 多引擎回退，并使用 Jsoup 解析真实结果
  • 🧭 域名过滤优化：搜索结果按规范化域名执行 allow/block 过滤，支持子域名匹配并过滤搜索页、脚本链接等噪声结果
  • 🧠 Skill 代码执行支持：SkillBox 启用临时工作目录、脚本/数据资源上传和受限 Shell 工具，scripts/、data/ 等资源可直接进入技能运行时
  • 🧹 工具面收敛：移除自定义 Skill 资源读取工具和环境变量读取工具，资源读取改由 SkillBox 内置能力承接，减少敏感信息暴露面
  • 🧾 工具详情可复制：工具调用详情弹窗改为聚焦只读 JSON 编辑器，参数和返回值支持快捷键快速选中与复制
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：发布版本提升至 v1.1.4.1，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1141

📦 Version v1.1.4.0

  • 📐 分割面板：插件面板现支持分割视图功能（目前仅支持左右分割），更好地组织工作空间
  • 📋 Log Console: Added enable/disable toggle for the logging console to reduce resource usage when not needed
  • 📋 日志控制台：新增日志控制台启用/禁用开关，在不需要时减少资源占用

📦 Version v1.0.7

  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Plugins can now support multiple simultaneous instances by overriding the supportMultiOpens function
  • 🪟 多实例支持：插件现可通过重载 supportMultiOpens 函数支持同时打开多个实例
  • 🔄 Panel Refactoring: Refactored showPanel and closePanel functions with new JComponent parameter for proper resource cleanup in multi-instance scenarios
  • 🔄 面板重构：重构 showPanel 和 closePanel 函数，新增 JComponent 参数，解决多实例场景下的资源回收问题
  • 🐛 Bug Fix: Fixed incorrect logger parameter in openProject callback when using drag-and-drop installation
  • 🐛 Bug 修复：修复拖动安装时 openProject 回调中 logger 参数错误的问题
  • ✨ Project Close Handler: Added automatic closePanel invocation when project is closed for opened panels
  • ✨ 项目关闭处理：新增项目关闭时自动调用已打开面板的 closePanel 函数

📦 Version v1.0.6

  • 📝 JS Templates: Added project templates for JavaScript plugin development, enabling quick demo code creation
  • 📝 JS 模板：JS 插件开发新增项目模板，可通过模板快速创建示例代码
  • 📦 JS Packaging: New packaging feature for JS plugins to create installable plugin packages from current project
  • 📦 JS 打包：JS 插件开发新增打包功能，可将当前项目打包成可安装的插件
  • 🔧 Native Development: Optimized native plugin development workflow, reducing complexity and learning curve
  • 🔧 原生开发：优化原生插件开发运行逻辑，降低开发难度和学习曲线

📦 Version v1.0.5

  • 🧹 Cleanup Optimization: Improved cleanup process for uninstalled plugins, ensuring no residual files remain
  • 🧹 清理优化：优化插件卸载后的清理流程，确保无残留文件

📦 Version v1.0.4

  • 📋 Log Console UX: JTools log console now uses soft-wrap mode for better log readability
  • 📋 日志控制台体验：JTools 日志控制台现使用软换行模式，提升日志可读性

📦 Version v1.0.3

  • 📌 Since Annotation: Added @Since annotation to SDK for version tracking and change documentation
  • 📌 Since 注解：SDK 新增 @Since 注解，用于版本追踪和变更记录
  • 📂 File Operations: Helper class now includes file selection and save dialog functions
  • 📂 文件操作：Helper 类新增文件选择和保存对话框相关函数
  • 📝 Editor Integration: Added openInEditor function to Helper for opening files in IDE editor
  • 📝 编辑器集成：Helper 新增 openInEditor 函数，用于在 IDE 编辑器中打开文件
  • 🔧 Toolbar Support: Added createActionToolbar function to Helper for creating custom toolbars
  • 🔧 工具栏支持：Helper 新增 createActionToolbar 函数，用于创建自定义工具栏
  • 🔄 API Change: Renamed IPlugin parameter from projectLocation to locationHash for clarity
  • 🔄 API 变更：IPlugin 入参函数名从 projectLocation 改为 locationHash，提升清晰度
  • 📊 SDK Version: Helper version updated to 103
  • 📊 SDK 版本：Helper 版本更新至 103
  • ✨ Action Button: actionButton function now supports isSelected parameter for toggle states
  • ✨ 操作按钮：actionButton 函数新增 isSelected 参数支持切换状态

📦 Version v1.0.2

  • 🔔 Notifications: Helper class now includes notify function with type support: IDE_UPDATE, INFORMATION, WARNING, ERROR
  • 🔔 通知功能：Helper 类新增 notify 函数，支持类型：IDE_UPDATE、INFORMATION、WARNING、ERROR
  • 📋 System Logger: Added getSysLogger function to Helper for accessing system-level logging
  • 📋 系统日志：Helper 新增 getSysLogger 函数，用于获取系统级日志
  • 📝 Language TextField: Added languageTextField function to Helper for creating IDE LanguageTextField components without direct IDEA plugin dependency
  • 📝 语言文本框：Helper 新增 languageTextField 函数，无需 IDEA 插件依赖即可创建 IDE 的 LanguageTextField 组件
  • 🔍 Compatibility Check: IPlugin now includes support function to verify JTools plugin compatibility (see jtools-notes plugin for usage example)
  • 🔍 兼容性检查：IPlugin 新增 support 函数，用于验证 JTools 插件兼容性（用法可参考 jtools-notes 插件）

  • 🎨 Icon Updates: Updated various plugin icons for better visual consistency
  • 🎨 图标更新：更新多个插件图标，提升视觉一致性
  • 🔗 Repository Link: Added plugin repository connection in settings panel
  • 🔗 仓库链接：在设置面板新增插件仓库连接
  • 🔧 Lifecycle Optimization: Improved plugin uninstall, install, and delete logic for better reliability
